outcome: Short-term maternal and perinatal adverse events
cohort: 117 women with a BMI >= 40 kg/m2 who reached term and had induction of labor planned to prevent prolonged pregnancy
finding: Women with morbid obesity who labored spontaneously had a high rate of vaginal delivery, but the rate of cesarean delivery increased dramatically when induction of labor was required.
mod_finding: Of the women who underwent induction of labor, only 45.8% achieved vaginal delivery, compared to 79.7% of those who labored spontaneously.
birth_weight: 22 (18.8%) of the babies weighed more than 4000g
